pr_title: Don't suggest commands when help flag is used
pr_body:
This fixes https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/1169

It wasn't working before because our custom command suggester was being run if the help flag was set. It would then interpret the help flag as a help command. I also noticed that `gh whatever -h` wasn't working and that is because we didn't define the help flag using `BoolP`. I think that must have been unintentional so I fixed that too. I verified that all these work now.

**root**
`gh help`
`gh -h`
`gh --help`

**sub-command**
`gh pr help`
`gh pr -h`
`gh pr --help`

**sub-sub-command**
`gh pr status help`
`gh pr status -h`
`gh pr status --help`
pr_comments:
Good catch!

Unfortunately I'm still getting unknown command for `gh pr -h` (but not `gh pr --help`):

- `gh pr --help` works
- `gh pr -h` doesn't work
- `gh pr status -h` works
- `gh -h` works
@vilmibm ahh, that's because big brain Corey didn't push that commit up to github! If you try it now it should work.

Went through the list of commands and all worked except:

```
gh pr status help

Relevant pull requests in cli/cli

Current branch
  #1185  Don't suggest commands when help flag is used [help-flag]
  × 6/10 checks failing - Review required

Created by you
  You have no open pull requests

Requesting a code review from you
  You have no pull requests to review
```
I think the result from `gh pr status help` is expected. The help command needs to be the first command after gh, or you need to use a help flag (-h --help)

I realized why we don't have the `-h` flag set for help. It's because other flags are already using it.

`gh config` uses it to set the host
`gh repo create` uses it to set the homepage

So we can either say "-h" doesn't show help, or we can rename the `-h` flags on config and repo create.

I think we should rename the `-h` flag in `gh config` and `gh repo create`.  
Traditionally, `-h` stands for help, and people would be expecting that here also
perhaps `repo create --website` and `config set --domain` would work better?

For `gh config --host` I got rid of the short `-h` flag
For `gh repo create --hostname` I changed it to `gh repo create --website` and `gh repo create -w`

issue_context.title: "LEARN MORE" section in help docs slightly wrong
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The "LEARN MORE" section in the new help docs suggest using `gh <command> <subcommand> --help` but that results in `unknown command --help`. The usage info is printed so the user's desire is largely fulfilled despite the confusing error at the top.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. run `gh help pr status`

### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected: we recommend `gh help <command> <subcommand>`

Actual: we recommend `gh <command> <subcommand> --help`
comments:
Does `--help` not work for any command?

I find it working for most commands:
```
$ gh pr status --help
Show status of relevant pull requests

USAGE
  gh pr status [flags]

LEARN MORE
  Use "gh <command> <subcommand> --help" for more information about a command.
  Read the manual at http://cli.github.com/manual
```

However, it doesn't work for `gh alias set`, since we've disabled flag parsing there. Maybe we can specifically re-enable it for that command? 

**Update:** ah, I see: it's broken for top-level commands that have subcommands:

```
$ gh config --help
unknown command "--help" for "gh config"
Display or change configuration settings for gh.
...
```

@mislav Are you opposed to disabling and not mentioning `--help`?

Given its currently broken behavior and the confusion of having two routes to seeing help docs, I'd rather us just support `gh help`.

> Are you opposed to disabling and not mentioning `--help`?

Not at all, but I feel more strongly about investigating the potential regression of why `--help` doesn't work anymore for some commands and see if there is an easy way to fix it. It's okay if we only document one style of invoking help, but I feel that there's value in both styles working since people might be expecting command-line tools to support `--help` in general and since Cobra was supposed to handle this for us.

review_comments:
I don't believe that we should change existing `-h` flags to support `-h` across the board. Cobra already does a decent job of automatically treating `-h` as `--help` for commands that don't have their own `-h` flag. If a specific command wants to declare its own `-h` flag, I believe we should support it.

I have opened an alternate PR to address the `help` vs `--help` vs `-h` situation  #1221
